Paper: Barona López et al. (Intelligent Systems with Applications)
Reported metrics: CNN Raw: 45.40%, CNN Post: 87.26%, LSTM Post: 90.55%
Limitations supported by evidence: LSTM inflates parameters 53x (+3.29 pp gain); 68.4% frame imbalance ignored under standard CE; severe open/waveOut dorsal extensor crosstalk (66% error)
Possible extension: Integrate Channel Attention (SE/ECA) to resolve crosstalk; apply Class-Weighted Focal Loss for frame imbalance; lightweight temporal projection
